title: Ambient line derivative of a locally Lipschitz map along a differentiable chart (Simon Ch. 2, (4.7), (4.10); parent Step 5)
statement: Let n, N, p ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝᴺ open, f : ℝᴺ → ℝᵖ locally Lipschitz on U, ψ : ℝⁿ → ℝᴺ and u ∈ ℝⁿ, with ψ(u) ∈ U, ψ differentiable at u and f∘ψ differentiable at u. Then for every w ∈ ℝⁿ the map t ↦ f(ψ(u) + t·Dψ(u)w) has derivative D(f∘ψ)(u)w at t = 0, i.e. HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w).
lean_statement: ∀ (n N p : ℕ) (U : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn p) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → ψ u ∈ U → DifferentiableAt ℝ ψ u → DifferentiableAt ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u → ∀ w : Rn n, HasLineDerivAt ℝ f (fderiv ℝ (f ∘ ψ) u w) (ψ u) (fderiv ℝ ψ u w)
